name: Tchogha Zanbil
description: In Iran's Khuzestan province, about 30 km southeast of Susa, rises the crumbling stepped tower of Tchogha Zanbil. This holy city of the Elamite kingdom was founded around 1250 BC and ringed by three massive concentric walls. Its ziggurat is among the few found outside Mesopotamia. Thousands of unused bricks still lie where builders left them when Assyrian invaders halted the work.
